## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the trigger and observable change. Identify hackathon contributions and any historical reference touched.

## Validation

- [ ] Regression test failed before implementation and now passes
- [ ] Hackathon tests and root tests pass
- [ ] Syntax and judge checks pass
- [ ] Gitleaks history and working-tree scans pass
- [ ] Browser desktop/mobile flow checked for interaction changes
- [ ] Matching run guide, controls and contribution docs reflect the change

## Review limits

Record any incomplete checks, live versus Sample evidence, accessibility limits and remaining risks. No keys, personal paths, real factory records or unredacted logs. Preserve consent, encryption, quotas, role boundaries and `operationalRelease: false`.
